readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 后来 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: After the crowned 后 queen gives her command, the next courtier arrives 后来（hòu lái）, “later”; hòu falls like the curtain between scenes. In traditional writing, this later sense appears as 後來.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 怎么 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: Trying the task for the first time, the worried heart bends toward the instructions, then looks up and asks 怎么（zěn me）, “how?” Let zěn dip and recover with that motion.
